_doc: TCSE P2-zero ENGINEERING-ONLY instance; not a benchmark result and not paper reproduction. The unmodified coding adapter, Terminus-2 H_0 and Algorithms 1 and 2, on a two-task evolve set (the coding instance's official smoke tasks extract-elf and fix-git), k=1, one candidate, one round. Every method hyperparameter is copied unchanged from domains/coding/rrsi.json; only the horizon and sample sizes (T, k, m) and the engineering knob repair_rounds are reduced so one round fits a Claude Pro allowance. Policy model, dataset and concurrency still come from domains/coding/rrsi.json and the RRSI_POLICY_* environment. With a weak policy every score is about 0, so selection is degenerate and says nothing about improvement.
